title: How chess travelled from India to the world ♟️
description:
Did you know chess was invented in India? Here is how chaturanga became the game we play today.

📌 Quick facts
• Chess began in India about 1,500 years ago as chaturanga, named for four divisions of an army
• In Persia it became shatranj, and checkmate comes from the Persian shah mat, roughly 'the king is helpless'
• Arab traders carried it to Spain and Europe, and it was popular in Europe by about the year 1000
• Elephants became bishops and chariots became rooks; the queen turned powerful around 1475
• Today hundreds of millions of people play (estimates vary)
Figures are approximate; see the sources before relying on a date.
